headline: AI Detected

A Belonging Deeper Than Any Group
The Guide also points beyond itself, toward a belonging deeper than any group, one that doesn’t ask you to give up being yourself.
That might be nature, or existence itself.
It might be whatever your tradition sees as ultimate.
Love can come from any of these places, and you also belong there, which is a little different. Maybe you’ve felt that outside somewhere, like you didn’t need anybody’s okay to be there.
The way in is time in nature and contemplative practice, like meditation.
With that under you, belonging with people can get a lot less desperate.
Not all at once, though. Your little one might still think, “If they stop liking me, I won’t belong anywhere,” and the Guide can remind it there’s more to belong to than them.
